bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
live="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
old="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pr62-20261120)" || exit 63
new="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-4a1c5be3)" || exit 64
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
if test "$live" = "$old"; then echo LIVE_IMAGE=ROLLBACK_ORIGINAL; elif test "$live" = "$new"; then echo LIVE_IMAGE=LINK_CANDIDATE; exit 74; else echo LIVE_IMAGE=UNKNOWN; exit 75; fi
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module -e '
import fs from "node:fs";
const p=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE;
const token=p?fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;
try {const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/getMe",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});const j=await r.json();if(!j.ok||j.result.username!=="GayBBS_bot")process.exit(68);}catch{process.exit(69)}
' || exit 70
echo BOT_API_WITH_IPV4=PASS
echo USERBOT_SERVICE=ACTIVE
